COST: 302

Notes on the plan:
- Car 2 is not used. Its only useful job would be the bus driver at Likhu market, and a round trip there (26 minutes) costs more than the 20-minute penalty for leaving that one adult behind.
- Car 1 takes the young woman and three elderly from Jwalamukhi instead of Car 2. That is cheaper because Car 1 is already at Benighat, and the round trip costs 28 minutes.
- Belkot school is not used as a drop-off point because it is not designated. The three shopkeepers there are carried to Benighat shelter.
- Deferred: one adult at Likhu market, one adult at Kakani farm, and two adults at Tadi farm. Rescuing the Tadi adults would add a 40-minute detour for the same 40-minute penalty, so they are deferred. The Kakani adult would need a 24-minute detour to save 20.
- Roads are assumed to be usable in both directions.
